title: Design System: NUDO Estudio de Pelo

display.purpose: Inner-page intro H1s; words enter one by one.

headline-lg.purpose: Night band and major section titles.

title.purpose: Stylist, product line and card titles.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked buttons, nav, action links, info-block labels.

figures.purpose: Tabular lining numerals for prices, durations, hours, counts.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: The single easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Button fill inversion, chip color, arrow 2px nudge.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: Underline color and offset tightening on hover.

motion.name: word-in
motion.purpose: Hero and page-intro headlines enter word by word (rise 0.35em plus clip).

motion.name: reveal-wipe
motion.value: scroll-driven view() timeline, 20px rise plus upward clip; IO fallback 600-700ms staggered 80ms

motion.name: panel-in
motion.purpose: Carta tab panels and FAQ answers.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Keyword marquee; pauses on hover and focus.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all of the above disabled; view transitions 0.01ms

texture.grain: Optional SVG feTurbulence overlay, opacity 0.035, multiply, off by default via a layout flag; not enabled on any shipped page.

narrative.overview:
The salon's price card is the interface. Everything reads like a well-set printed menu on warm cream paper: a soft, low-contrast serif for names and promises, a precise sans with tabular figures for prices and durations, 1px rules and dotted leaders joining a service to its "desde" price. The site is calm and unhurried, the way the salon claims to be: generous section air, one dark espresso band per page for the room itself, and photography of the work carrying the persuasion.

The system is flat and editorial. Depth comes from paper tones (cream ground, sand bands, lighter carta paper, one espresso night band), never from shadows. Actions are chocolate, rectangular and nearly square-cornered with tracked uppercase labels; pills are reserved for things you pick (category chips) or read as a tag (badges). The one signature form is the arch, a mirror-shaped photo crop used once per page.

Motion is quiet and directional: hero headlines enter word by word, sections reveal with a short upward clip-path wipe, salon photos drift a few percent on scroll, a slow keyword marquee runs at 60s. Every one of these is off under reduced motion, and content is visible without JS.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper ground with sand and espresso bands; flat, no elevation.
Fraunces (wght + opsz subset, optical size auto) at weight 380, never bold; one italic bronze word per key headline.
Manrope for UI, tabular lining figures for every price and duration.
Carta rows: name, dotted leader, "desde $" price, clock-and-duration line, Reservar link, 1px rules.
Rectangular 2px chocolate buttons with uppercase tracked labels.
Photos at 4px; one arch-cropped photo per page.
Headlines stand alone: no small label above them.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by tone, in the order cream ground, sand band, carta paper, espresso night. A new section picks a paper; it never lifts with a shadow.

rules.name: The Small Bronze Rule
rules.body: Bronze below 24px is always Bronze Strong. Plain Bronze at small sizes is for icons and decoration only.

rules.name: The One Night Rule
rules.body: One espresso band per page, carrying the room (photos of the salon, philosophy, products). Inside it, every accent switches to its on-night pair.

rules.name: The One Italic Word Rule
rules.body: A key headline may italicize one word or short phrase in bronze, written in copy as `*word*`. Today: hero, night band, final CTA, Servicios carta heading. Not every heading gets one.

rules.name: The Standalone Headline Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a headline. Uppercase labels title lists and info blocks (Dirección, Horarios, Condiciones), never a section heading.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number a client compares (price, duration, hours, counts) is tabular and lining.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow, at rest or on hover. State is shown by fill inversion, color, underline offset or a 2px translate of an arrow icon.

rules.name: The One Arch Rule
rules.body: One arch-cropped photo per page, always a 3:4 or 4:5 portrait. A second arch dilutes the signature.

dos: **Do** separate sections by paper tone (cream, sand, carta paper, one espresso night band) and 1px linen rules.
**Do** set every price and duration in tabular lining figures, prefixed with "desde" in muted.
**Do** keep primary actions as 2px rectangular chocolate buttons with uppercase 13px labels tracked at 0.14em, at least 48px tall.
**Do** switch every accent to its on-night pair inside the night band (bronze-on-night, on-night at 80% for copy, 20% for rules).
**Do** use Bronze Strong for any bronze text under 24px.
**Do** crop exactly one portrait photo per page with the arch; keep other photos at 4px (16px only for large salon photos in the night band).
**Do** use Lucide icons as inline SVG at stroke 1.5 in currentColor or bronze.
**Do** gate motion behind reduced-motion and keep content visible without JS; ease with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
donts: **Don't** add shadows to anything, at rest or on hover.
**Don't** set Fraunces bold or in all caps; hierarchy is size, never weight.
**Don't** place a small label, kicker or eyebrow above a headline.
**Don't** italicize more than one word or phrase per headline, or give every heading one.
**Don't** use pills for primary buttons; pills are for chips, badges and circular controls.
**Don't** hardcode colors in components; use the palette tokens only.
**Don't** add decorative gradients; the only fades run from a photo into the cream ground.
**Don't** use plain Bronze for body-size text.
